correctness.rationale: The full three-state no-self-loop stationary-flow polytope has affine coordinates (a,b,J), c=1-a-b, activities a_i>=|J|. Constant affine Euclidean Jacobian and a triangle cross-section of scale (1-3|J|) give w=3|J| with density 3(1-w)² and independent uniform Dirichlet(1,1,1) simplex activities; the balanced stationary section fixes activities 1/3 and yields uniform w. The exact entropy-production expression is Σ=w/3 sum_i log[1+2w/(3(1-w)u_i)] and balanced Σ=w log((1+w)/(1-w)). Direct independent SymPy integration of four explicit terms gives E_sta=-1/2+log(9/4)=0.31093021621632877 and E_bal=1. The pointwise exponential bound δ^{-t} prod u_i^{-t/3}, δ=1-w, is integrable under 3δ² and Dirichlet marginal exactly for t<3; an interior simplex patch supplies divergence for t>=3. Balanced δ-uniform yields t<1 and P(Σ>s)~2e^{-s}; exponential Markov bound combined with matching interior patch gives full-ensemble log-tail rate -3. No density or constant prefactor for full tail claimed.
